mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) has a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production growth (INDPRO) during the early post-pandemic recovery phase signals supply chain disruptions and rising input costs, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during early post-pandemic recovery when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change < 2.5%) indicates the Federal Reserve will maintain accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive negative growth in industrial production (INDPRO) for two months signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate investment and earnings expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is negative for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 6-month moving averages indicates a self-reinforcing demand cycle, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) has a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST are above their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement aggressive monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.
